column3: “Peter” and else are supplied; say renders answer.
“Replied” supplies answering; why then renders how.
The mute spirit becomes a spirit causing muteness.
“To the ground” and at the mouth are supplied; becoming rigid renders drying up.
“Jesus” supplies the subject; boy specifies him.
“Jesus” and the boy specify pronouns; at the mouth is supplied.
“Or” replaces the coordination of fire and water.
Deaf and mute are in reverse order.
“The spirit” and the boy specify the pronouns.
“Jesus answered” supplies the name and answering.
